source.theorem_and_proof_summary: The theorem assumes two sigma-finite measure spaces and an unsigned function measurable for the product sigma-algebra. It asserts measurability of both iterated section integrals and equality of product integral with both iterated integrals. The proof reduces to finite measure by increasing finite-measure exhaustion and monotone convergence; then to simple functions and indicators; the good measurable-set class is monotone, contains rectangles and their finite disjoint unions, hence contains the product sigma-algebra by the monotone class lemma. This is the exact theorem stated in the local carrier; incomplete means the uncompleted product sigma-algebra version, not an unfinished proof.
